tools.name: idx_get_account_info
tools.description: The IDX Broker client account this access key belongs to: company and contact details and account settings (access keys and passwords are never returned). The reply also shows how many of the key's hourly API accesses are used. GET /clients/accountinfo.

tools.name: idx_get_account_type
tools.description: The IDX Broker plan of the account (Lite or Platinum). It sets the hourly API limit: 300 accesses per key on Lite, 500 on Platinum. GET /clients/accounttype.

tools.name: idx_list_agents
tools.description: Agents on a multi-user IDX Broker account (id, name, office, contact details, category, language, login dates). Filter by one field or by a time window. GET /clients/agents.

tools.name: idx_list_offices
tools.description: Offices on a multi-user IDX Broker account. Filter by one field or by a time window. GET /clients/offices.

tools.name: idx_list_leads
tools.description: List the account's leads (website registrants) with contact details, status, agent owner, and last viewed listings and searches. A reply holds up to 500 leads; pass offset to page on and look for pagination information in the reply. Filter by a time window on signup, edit, login or activity date. Us

tools.name: idx_get_lead
tools.description: One lead by id with its details, last 5 viewed listings and searches, and the total number of listings viewed. GET /leads/lead/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_list_lead_notes
tools.description: Notes on a lead, or one note when note_id is given. GET /leads/note/{leadID}[/{noteID}].

tools.name: idx_list_lead_searches
tools.description: Saved property searches of a lead (or one search when search_id is given), with the results URL of each. GET /leads/search/{leadID}[/{searchID}].

tools.name: idx_list_lead_saved_properties
tools.description: Properties a lead saved (or one when property_id is given). GET /leads/property/{leadID}[/{propertyID}].

tools.name: idx_get_lead_traffic
tools.description: Website traffic history of one lead: date, page, referrer and IP of each visit (at most 5,000 rows per request; use interval/offset/limit to narrow it). GET /leads/leadtraffic/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_list_featured_listings
tools.description: The account's featured (active) listings with address, price, status, photos and agent. Only the account's own listings are returned, never general MLS data. GET /clients/featured.

tools.name: idx_list_sold_pending_listings
tools.description: The account's sold and pending listings, that is those removed from the MLS feed. GET /clients/soldpending.

tools.name: idx_list_off_market_listings
tools.description: The account's off-market listings. GET /clients/offmarket.

tools.name: idx_list_supplemental_listings
tools.description: The account's supplemental (non-MLS) listings with a basic set of fields. GET /clients/supplemental.

tools.name: idx_list_saved_links
tools.description: Saved links (pre-built property search pages) of the account with id, name and URL. GET /clients/savedlinks.

tools.name: idx_get_saved_link_count
tools.description: The total number of properties a saved link currently matches. GET /clients/savedlinks/{savedLinkID}/count.

tools.name: idx_list_widgets
tools.description: The JavaScript widgets on the account with id, name, URL and options. GET /clients/widgets.

tools.name: idx_get_widget
tools.description: One JavaScript widget with its settings. GET /clients/widgets/{id}.

tools.name: idx_list_system_links
tools.description: The system pages of the account's site (search, featured, contact...) with name, id and URL, which can be linked to directly. GET /clients/systemlinks.

tools.name: idx_list_approved_mls
tools.description: The MLSs approved for display on the account, with their IDX ids (such as a001) and names. Use the id in the other MLS tools. GET /mls/approvedmls.

tools.name: idx_get_mls_age
tools.description: When an MLS feed was last downloaded and processed and when its images were last gathered (UTC). GET /mls/age/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_list_mls_property_types
tools.description: Property types of an MLS with the IDX type id, the MLS name, the parent type and subtypes. GET /mls/propertytypes/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_list_mls_search_fields
tools.description: The fields of an MLS that can be searched under MLS rules: field name, display name and the property types they belong to. GET /mls/searchfields/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_list_mls_locations
tools.description: Cities, counties or postal codes present in an MLS's data, with ids and a count of occurrences. Filter fields: cities = cityID, cityName, stateAbrv, mlsPtID; counties = countyID, countyName, stateAbrv, mlsPtID; postalcodes = id, stateAbrv, mlsPtID. GET /mls/{cities|counties|postalcodes}/{idxID}.

tools.name: idx_create_lead
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new lead in the IDX Broker account (and may trigger the account's own lead notifications). Needs a correctly formatted email with a valid MX record; IDX rejects bad addresses with a server error. Extra fields go in `fields` by their IDX name, as seen on a lead returned by idx_get_le

tools.name: idx_add_lead_note
tools.description: WRITE: adds a note to a lead (visible to the account's agents). Returns the new note id. PUT /leads/note/{leadID}.

tools.name: idx_update_lead
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of an existing lead; the given values replace the stored ones. Only pass what must change. Field names are the IDX lead field names as seen on a lead returned by idx_get_lead (for example firstName, lastName, email, phone, status). POST /leads/lead/{leadID}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "idx_get_account_info" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: idx_list_lead_searches, idx_list_sold_pending_listings, idx_list_saved_links, idx_list_widgets, idx_list_system_links, idx_get_mls_age · Private data: idx_get_account_info, idx_list_agents, idx_list_leads, idx_list_system_links, idx_create_lead · Public sink: idx_create_lead, idx_update_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: idx_list_lead_searches, idx_list_sold_pending_listings, idx_list_saved_links, idx_list_widgets, idx_list_system_links, idx_get_mls_age · Private data: idx_get_account_info, idx_list_agents, idx_list_leads, idx_list_system_links, idx_create_lead · Public sink: idx_create_lead, idx_update_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
